materialChanges: Expanded the existing power-law worked example with a physical setting, explicit givens, constraints, unknowns, plan, units, boundary conditions, interpretation, independent check, and self-explanation prompt.
Declared the nonzero-k family-identification boundary and the all-zero degenerate case in the concept explanation, claim scopes, and glossary.
Removed inline answers from the practice, microscope-transfer, and clearance-transfer scenes and consolidated their reasoning-rich answers in a later feedback scene.

Replaced the unsupported dose inference with a strictly fictional comparison of direct and 0.75-power clearance candidates using predictions, residuals, model selection, transfer, and explicit limitations.
Mapped the clearance and feedback scenes to all applicable claims and learner-visible source notes, and restored every candidate claim to pending-review.
Rephrased the accessibility section as learner-facing guidance while preserving the equation, table, verbal, non-colour, and nonvisual routes.

reviewDispositions.rationale: scene-clinical-wrap-up is now claims-mapped, appears in all four applicable claim sceneIds, and contains a same-scene source note naming every supporting source; the added feedback scene is mapped the same way.

The title, prompt, and feedback no longer infer any dose rule. The revised task compares only author-invented fictional clearance models and explicitly excludes treatment, patient-care, causal, and medical-advice interpretations.
All four claim reviewStatus values are pending-review, consistent with the unchanged draft lesson status and pending-review source confidence.
The concept scene now assumes nonzero k when distinguishing families and states that all-zero observations are degenerate. Matching claim scopes and glossary definitions preserve that boundary.
This note independently confirmed the six existing assessment answer keys and scene calculations. The final revision does not change assessment.json, and the cited numerical results remain correct.

worked-example-power-table now identifies a five-square-pad task, givens, constraints, unknowns, plan, positive domain, units, fixed-shape boundary, ordered reasoning, coordinate and dimensional checks, contextual interpretation, and a prompt about the decisive scale-factor step.

The four practice answers were removed from the prompt scene. Learners are directed to record all attempts first; feedback is in the later scene-feedback rather than immediately beneath each question.
Detailed microscope and fictional-clearance answers were removed from their prompt scenes and placed after both tasks in scene-feedback, separating the transfer attempts from answer discussion.
The clearance scene is claims-mapped and linked to power-law scaling, invariants, log-linearization, and model-checking in claims.json, with the complete source union exposed in its source note.

The final transfer now requires parameterizing and comparing competing direct and 0.75-power models, calculating signed residuals, selecting the closer candidate, adapting it for a new prediction, and proposing a discriminating observation.
The prompt now asks for the required positivity condition, and feedback explicitly states M > 0, CL > 0, and b > 0 before taking real base-10 logarithms.

The accessibility section now speaks directly to learners about choosing equations, coordinate tables, or written scale-factor descriptions and explains the nonvisual route without project or audit vocabulary.

evidenceChecked: All nine ordered scene sources have one level-one heading and a logical text-first reading order; practice and transfer prompts precede the later feedback scene.

Equations, coordinate tables, units, scale-factor descriptions, and prose interpretations provide nonvisual mathematical routes; no distinction depends on colour, position, sound, motion, hover, drag, or timing.
The pack contains no figures, diagrams, audio, video, third-party assets, executable code, raw HTML, Markdown images, remote embeds, or personal learner or patient data.
The fictional pump, sensor-pad, microscope, dataset, and clearance cases state their educational boundaries and do not direct clinical, laboratory, forecasting, or engineering action.
Every claims-mapped scene has a learner-visible source note; every mapped claim resolves to the three existing NIST reference records and their declared factual-reference use.
All source records use facts-only-original-expression, include concrete rights-basis evidence, and record checked-no-agent-restriction-found with dated terms routes from 2026-07-22.
The lesson declares CC BY 4.0, thirdPartyAssets is empty, ATTRIBUTION.md identifies accountable authorship and material author-agent assistance, and this artifact discloses the fresh finalizer run.
limitations: No live screen-reader, keyboard, 200% zoom, narrow-viewport, print, reduced-motion, or non-web export test was run; the audit inspected canonical semantic source only.
The dated NIST rights and agent-access records were inspected but not rechecked on the network during this scoped finalization.

The user scope prohibited reading site schemas and quorum JSON, checking GitHub directly, and running npm source preflight or repository validation; the adjudication follows the supplied eligible-review context and repository adjudication template instead.

rationale: The exact original candidate and both eligible advisory artifacts were read in full. The two inputs identify one academic and one learning-design role, two distinct run IDs, two declared provider/model families, one accountable principal, zero approvals, and two request-changes verdicts against the same candidate. Their provenance is disclosed and attested rather than independently verified; COMMENTED transport eligibility is taken from the operator-supplied context. The bounded final revision incorporates every requested content change and leaves the academic numerical-confirmation note unchanged. Scoped checks confirmed JSON syntax, string-typed acceptable responses, lesson identity/version/status, 100-minute scene total, claim/source-note coverage, source-field constraints, unchanged frozen reviews, Markdown structure, absence of raw HTML or active content, and clean diffs. The final accessibility-and-rights audit found no unresolved academic, instructional, access, privacy, security, attribution, or reuse blocker. Subject to the recorded operator-only stamping and validation conditions, merge is justified.
dissent: Both eligible reviewers requested changes to the original candidate, and neither reviewed the final revision. Their original objections remain preserved in the frozen artifacts; eleven change findings were incorporated and the academic numerical-confirmation note required no content change.
conditions: The operator must commit this final lesson revision, replace PENDING-FINAL-COMMIT with that exact 40-character content commit, and stamp the four RUNTIME-STAMPED adjudicator agent fields without changing teaching content.

The operator must run the repository's strict source preflight and full sequential verification outside this scoped run and resolve any failure before merge; a substantive content change would require a new authorized governance path.
After a valid final commit and adjudication, the maintainer may make only the permitted publication transition for lesson status, source confidence, and retained claim reviewStatus fields.
